entries.title: Listen to Super Mario Maker 2
entries.curator_note:
Listen to the music of Nintendo sound team
Super Mario Maker 2
entries.recording_collection_scope: 281 available real source-indexed game-score passages from three archival collector parts. Missing unindexed tails and an unclear legacy/unused challenge cue remain excluded. Not a complete official album or exhaustive game-stem inventory.

album_completeness.scope: Available public score and game-style variants, with real source boundaries; no audio-identical or physical console-playback claim.

entries.title: Listen to Luigi's Mansion 3
entries.curator_note:
Listen to the music of Next Level Games music team
Luigi's Mansion 3
entries.recording_collection_scope: 318 available unextended archival game/mode recordings from the cited public collection. Three cached native-unavailable recordings remain excluded; no claim of a complete official album or every game stem.

album_completeness.scope: Available public score and gameplay/mode variations. Extended duplicates and fan edits excluded; later modes retained with honest scope rather than false launch-year claims.

entries.title: Listen to Astral Chain
entries.composer: Satoshi Igarashi, Naofumi Harada, Hitomi Kurokawa, Masahiro Aoki and Satoshi Setsune

Listen to the music of Astral Chain
Satoshi Igarashi, Naofumi Harada, Hitomi Kurokawa, Masahiro Aoki and Satoshi Setsune
entries.recording_collection_scope: 97 named source-authored windows: 80 main tracks and 17 bonus versions, including source-labelled unused material, stems and an alternate loop. The unindexed final noise/cutscene section is excluded. Not independently exhaustive or an official complete album master.

Listen to music from The Simpsons: Hit & Run

entries.recording_collection_scope: 42 named windows from a public original-game music archive, plus three previously reviewed individual recordings preserved exactly. Some themes overlap the existing recordings; this is an expanded available collection, not45 unique compositions, a commercial album or exhaustive game-score claim.
